q: The doctor advised him to stop smoking, but he did not take the ______ seriously.
why: take the advice 意为“听从建议”。

q: More and more people realize the ______ of protecting the environment.
why: the importance of… 意为“……的重要性”。

q: The little boy showed great ______ in music and could play the piano at four.
why: show interest in… 对……表现出兴趣。interest 为名词。

q: Many students find it hard to ______ new words in their minds.
why: remember 记住；remind 提醒；remain 保持；remove 移除。

q: Please ______ your homework carefully before you hand it in.
why: check 检查；hand in 上交。

q: They ______ a class meeting to discuss the plan last Friday.
why: hold a meeting 举行会议，过去式为 held。

q: The science museum is open every day ______ Monday.
why: except 除……之外；注意区分 expect(期待)/accept(接受)。

q: If you do not know a word, you can ______ it in a dictionary.
why: look up a word in a dictionary 在词典中查词。

q: You are supposed to ______ the library books on time.
why: return the books 还书；be supposed to 应该。

q: Spring in the south is warm and ______, which makes people feel good.
why: comfortable 舒适的；common 普通的；confident 自信的。
